en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couplets on the Non-Causal and the With-Cause (Nahetusahetukaduka).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, not-root, and with-root, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, not-root, and without-root by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six under root;
six under predominance … pe … three under mutuality … pe … six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, not-a-root, and rootless, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, reactive, not-a-root, and rootless, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition, there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition, there are three.
